newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian, 13, kills herself over unrequited love.
newsitem.headline: Italian, 13, kills herself over unrequited love.

text.p: A love-struck 13-year-old Italian girl killed herself by swallowing a packet of heart pills after a man she met on holiday failed to respond to her advances, police said on Wednesday.

They said the girl, who lived in the southern port city of Naples but has not been named, was rushed to hospital after her father heard her screaming in the middle of the night after having taken the pills late on Tuesday.
She left no suicide note and police said they believed she had only planned a dramatic gesture to attract the attention of Gabriele, a 20-year-old holiday camp worker.

The girl had written and telephoned repeatedly since meeting him this summer but he had not replied. Police said the last straw appeared to have been when her brother received a letter on Tuesday from a girl he had met on the same holiday.
